identityPolicy: Group by field + positive NIRCam_DR5_ID, never by program-local NIRSpec_ID. Missing photometric IDs retain independent observation IDs. All 5190 grouped observations retained. Only positive A/B/C redshifts determine map positions or conflicts; D/E stay in provenance, never disqualifying a reliable A/B/C measurement. Groups without an accepted z remain unclassified and Atlas-only, with no invented distance. A/B/C priority and stable observation ID choose a representative, never invent a sigma. CCPC table6 duplicate source rows retained under one Name; source mean z is distinguished from main-table median. Full original cosmic source catalogue and final core checked for overlaps.
